text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Thursday it had started coverage of the Netherlands' Qiagen NV with a rating of overweight buy.
-- "In only 10 years Qiagen has attained world market leadership (15 percent market share) in the separation and purification of nucleic acids," Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a report.

-- "Given that nucleic acid purification is essential to the entire biotech industry, it is reasonable to expect Qiagen to grow at least with the entire industry without being overly exposed to any participant or product."
-- "... For the next five years sales growth (is) forecasted at 35 percent per annum, net earnings growth rate projected at +50 percent per annum.
-- American Depositary Receipts in the company opened unchanged at 33.
